notes: All cultures were washed into medium lacking glucose >=30 min before arabinose induction; applied to every sample, so treatment none and carbon_source glycerol (casamino acids also present). Empty-vector samples induced with arabinose are controls. genotype_class left out for ToxN samples (origin of toxN not stated, native vs heterologous unknown). Library gel extraction is of the finished library (normal).

growth_phase.q: Overnight cultures were back diluted into fresh media and grown 3-4 hours to an OD600 of ~0.35 at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM.

culture_mode.q: Overnight cultures were back diluted into fresh media and grown 3-4 hours to an OD600 of ~0.35 at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM.
